values.note: No bathhouse, so RVs without their own bathroom are not allowed. Cable/satellite TV at every site; canoe/kayak launch.

values.note: Reserve by phone or email (904-458-7275, office open weekdays 12-2 pm). Mainly monthly: short stays are offered only when sites are free. Gated entry by key code; background checks on all occupants.

note: Shaded campground on US-1 at Pellicer Creek, south of St Augustine near Faver-Dykes State Park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site (updated 2026-08-13): $65 a night with electricity, 34 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites with cable and Wi-Fi, laundry, no bathhouse (showers false). Added count, booking (phone/email) and the no-bathhouse rule. Note trimmed of hookup/price/rating text. Main finding: the park says it is mainly monthly.
flags: Criteria (long-stay rule): the operator says 'We are mainly a long-term park offering monthly reservations. We do offer short-term rentals when we have availability', 'Majority of our sites are reserved for monthly reservations only. On a limited basis we are able to offer a daily or weekly stay', 'We accept mainly monthly reservations', sites 'each designed for long-term stays', background checks on all occupants, storage sheds allowed with approval, rent due on the 1st with 30-day move-out notice. Looks mostly seasonal/long-stay under AWH's five-test rule - candidate to drop.
Price gate: $65 a night (operator, 2026) is over US$50, but it is 28 km from St. Augustine (attraction) per gateways.py, so the gateway exception applies.
No bathhouse: RVs without their own bathroom are not accepted (fine for EKKO).
